newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel prices follow NYMEX higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel prices follow NYMEX higher.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel prices firmed by almost one penny a gallon on Wednesday afternoon, tracking gains on NYMEX heating oil futures market, industry sources said.
Inventory concerns were reportedly behind the NYMEX gains, they added.
But differentials were little changed. New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade jet fuel was talked at about 4.00/4.25 cents over September futures.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade was offered at 1.50 cents over the print, also stable.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
